contract.intent: Separate artifact acceptance from protocol completion in benchmark evidence without weakening fail-closed comparisons.

outcomes.statement: Baseline evidence records artifact acceptance independently from protocol completion.
The benchmark report exposes artifact acceptance while keeping incomplete-baseline duration claims unavailable.
The two measurement dimensions and their limitations are documented.

checks.command: pnpm --filter @agentskit/harness build && pnpm --filter @agentskit/harness test:metrics && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs','--collect','--repeats','3','--phase-root','.codex/verification/phase-37/benchmark'],{encoding:'utf8'}); const x=JSON.parse(r.stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/).at(-1)); const ok=x.report.qualityGate.status==='insufficient-data' && x.report.comparisons.every(c=>['baseline-incomplete','harness-not-run'].includes(c.comparability) && c.improvement.duration==='unavailable' && c.baselineArtifactAcceptanceRate===null); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['comparison-integrity'],qualityGate:x.report.qualityGate.status}))"

node scripts/verify-harness-package.mjs && pnpm check:doc-bridge-config && pnpm check:readme-standard && test -f packages/harness/docs/ADR-0039-artifact-and-protocol-metrics.md && node -e "console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['docs']}))"
